SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - NOT LAW. Written for the evalgate test suite only.

Fixture Regulation A on reporting obligations

CHAPTER I
General provisions

Article 1
Subject matter
This fixture instrument establishes reporting obligations for importers of
covered goods. It applies from 1 October 2023 and does not create any legal
effect outside the evalgate test suite.

Article 2
Scope
This instrument applies to goods listed in Annex I imported into the customs
territory. It does not apply to goods of negligible value, meaning consignments
whose total intrinsic value does not exceed EUR 150 per consignment.

CHAPTER II
Obligations of the reporting declarant

Article 3
Quarterly report
The reporting declarant shall submit a report for each quarter of a calendar
year no later than one month after the end of that quarter. The report shall
state the total quantity of each type of covered good, expressed in megawatt
hours for electricity and in tonnes for other goods.

Article 4
Embedded emissions
Embedded emissions shall be calculated in accordance with the methods set out
in Annex II. Where actual emissions data cannot be adequately determined, the
reporting declarant may use default values for a transitional period ending on
31 July 2024.

Article 5
Corrections
A submitted report may be corrected by the reporting declarant for a period of
two months after the submission deadline. For reports due in the first two
quarters, the correction period is extended to the submission deadline of the
third quarterly report.

ANNEX I
Covered goods
Cement, electricity, fertilisers, iron and steel, aluminium and hydrogen.

ANNEX II
Calculation methods
Direct emissions shall be determined at installation level. Indirect emissions
shall be determined from the electricity consumed during the production
process, using either actual emission factors or the default factor for the
country of origin.
